subject.title: WhatsApp QR-unavailable/headless login needs phone-code fallback

question: Should WhatsApp phone-code login be exposed through the generic channel login contract and CLI flag, or should the entrypoint stay WhatsApp-owned inside the plugin?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear, but the active fixes expand public channel auth/CLI surface and touch persisted WhatsApp session classification, so maintainer intent is needed before implementation is accepted.

options.title: Accept Generic Login Method After Proof
options.body: Keep the typed generic phone-number login method used by the active PRs, but require conflict resolution, QR compatibility, session-state tests, and live WhatsApp pairing proof before merge.

options.title: Move To WhatsApp-Owned Login Surface
options.body: Rework the fallback so phone-code pairing stays local to the WhatsApp plugin without expanding the shared channel-auth contract.

options.title: Pause Until Live Pairing Is Proven
options.body: Keep this issue open but defer API acceptance until a branch demonstrates the Baileys pairing flow against a physical WhatsApp device.

recommendation.title: Accept Generic Login Method After Proof
recommendation.body: Keep the typed generic phone-number login method used by the active PRs, but require conflict resolution, QR compatibility, session-state tests, and live WhatsApp pairing proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent WhatsApp login and channel-auth history makes this the strongest available routing owner for the public CLI/plugin API direction.
